phase: Phase 1: Thesis Freezing and Data Gate

hourly_prices_and_flow.zero_denominator_policy: Retain the price bar; exclude the timestamp from both baseline and augmented flow diagnostics; do not impute flow.

funding_and_event_marks.mark_price_source: Binance USD-M markPriceKlines, 1h interval, candle open at the UTC hour containing each funding event.

source_discrepancy.finding: The prior manifest claims canonical mark_price values are finite and positive. The direct source and processed-file audits found historical mark_price values null. v3 was superseded before any trial. v4 uses the prior funding files only for event timestamps, symbols, funding intervals, and rates; v4 mark_price values come from the separate documented markPriceKlines source.

limitations: The event-aligned hourly mark-candle open is not the exact transaction mark. Its observed timestamp is 0-47 ms before the recorded funding event; Binance states actual funding transaction timing can deviate by up to 15 seconds.
Hourly fills cannot resolve intra-minute funding-versus-order priority; the frozen pre-open position rule is a deterministic convention.
The CLI identity audit alone does not certify calendar completeness, funding alignment, or point-in-time correctness. The coverage checks above establish those declared inputs only.
All data through 2026-07-31 is development or previously accessed evidence. The prospective holdout begins 2026-08-01 and remains unopened.
